description: Backend infrastructure setup: Express server, MongoDB connection, Mongoose models (User, Post, Vote with compound index), JWT authentication system with bcrypt, auth and admin middleware, input validation, centralized error handler, and seed script with 1 admin + 8-10 sample posts
steps: 1. Create server/package.json with dependencies: express, mongoose, bcryptjs, jsonwebtoken, dotenv, express-validator, cors, and nodemon as devDependency
2. Create server/.env.example with PORT, MONGO_URI, JWT_SECRET, JWT_EXPIRE (default values: 5000, mongodb://localhost:27017/feedbackboard, yoursecretkey, 30d)
3. Create server/config/db.js - MongoDB connection function using mongoose.connect with MONGO_URI from env, error handling

4. Create server/models/User.js - Mongoose schema: name (required), email (unique, required, lowercase), password (required, min 6 chars), role (enum: user/admin, default user), createdAt (default Date.now). Add pre-save hook to hash password with bcrypt if modified. Add method comparePassword(candidatePassword) returning bcrypt.compare result

5. Create server/models/Post.js - Mongoose schema: title (required, trim), description (required), category (enum: feature/bug/improvement, required), status (enum: open/planned/in-progress/shipped, default open), author (ref User, required), voteCount (Number, default 0), adminReply (String, optional), timestamps true. Add indexes on status, category, createdAt

6. Create server/models/Vote.js - Mongoose schema: user (ref User, required), post (ref Post, required), createdAt (default Date.now). Add compound unique index on [user, post] using schema.index({ user: 1, post: 1 }, { unique: true })

7. Create server/middleware/auth.js - Extract token from req.headers.authorization (Bearer token), verify with jwt.verify and JWT_SECRET, decode to get userId, fetch user from DB excluding password, attach to req.user, handle expired/invalid tokens with 401 error
8. Create server/middleware/adminOnly.js - Check req.user.role === 'admin', if not return 403 { success: false, message: 'Admin access required' }

9. Create server/middleware/errorHandler.js - Centralized error handler: catch all errors, log them, return JSON { success: false, message: error.message or 'Server Error', errors: validation errors array if present }. Handle mongoose validation errors, duplicate key errors (11000), and cast errors specially

10. Create server/middleware/validate.js - Input validation rules using express-validator: registerValidation (name required, email valid, password min 6), loginValidation (email valid, password required), postValidation (title required 3-100 chars, description required 10-1000 chars, category in enum), statusValidation (status in enum, adminReply optional max 500 chars). Export middleware that runs validationResult and returns 400 with errors array if validation fails

11. Create server/controllers/authController.js - register: validate input, check if user exists (email), create user with role hardcoded to 'user', sign JWT with userId and role, return token + user (exclude password). login: validate input, find user by email, compare password, sign JWT, return token + user. getMe: return req.user (already populated by auth middleware)
12. Create server/routes/authRoutes.js - POST /register with registerValidation, POST /login with loginValidation, GET /me with auth middleware

13. Create server/server.js - Load dotenv, import express, cors, connectDB, routes, errorHandler. Initialize app, use cors, express.json, routes (/api/auth, /api/posts), errorHandler as last middleware. Connect to DB then listen on PORT with console log

14. Create server/utils/seed.js - Script to clear Users, Posts, Votes collections, create admin user (email: admin@feedbackboard.com, password: Admin123!, role: admin, name: Admin User), create 8-10 sample posts with varied categories/statuses authored by admin, assign 3-8 random voteCount to each post. Log success message and process.exit(0)
15. Add scripts to server/package.json: 'start': 'node server.js', 'dev': 'nodemon server.js', 'seed': 'node utils/seed.js'
acceptance_criteria: Running 'cd server && npm install' installs all dependencies without errors
server/.env.example exists with all required variables documented
MongoDB models are defined with correct schemas, indexes, and methods
Auth middleware correctly verifies JWT and attaches user to request, returns 401 for invalid/expired tokens
Admin middleware returns 403 for non-admin users
Error handler formats all errors consistently as { success: false, message, errors? }
POST /api/auth/register creates user with role 'user', returns JWT token
POST /api/auth/login validates credentials and returns JWT token
GET /api/auth/me returns current user when valid token provided
Seed script creates 1 admin and 8-10 posts, runs without errors with 'npm run seed'
verification: Run 'cd server && npm install' - should complete successfully
Copy server/.env.example to server/.env and fill in values
Ensure MongoDB is running (mongod or Atlas connection)
Run 'cd server && npm run seed' - should output success message
Run 'cd server && npm run dev' - should start server on specified port
Test with curl or Postman: POST /api/auth/register with { name, email, password } - should return token and user with role 'user'
Test POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials - should return token
Test GET /api/auth/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> - should return user object
Test GET /api/auth/me without token - should return 401
Verify MongoDB collections contain admin user and sample posts
